name: averqel-desktop
description: AverQel is an AI workspace for document management and search, source-grounded questions, DeepSpace conversations and agent workflows, configurable model providers, approved connected apps, Qel Connect shared spaces and messaging, feedback and support, and tenant-aware security and administration. Provider and app integrations require configuration; Qel Connect is experimental beta.

scripts.build:linux: pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never --linux deb
scripts.build:windows: pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg --universal
